Two honest caveats: unhedged, the risk-reward is poor (roughly $2.6 of upside against a break to a standalone sub-scale foundry worth a fraction of the deal price), so the trade only works hedged 0.5265-to-1 against IONQ; and I could not verify the merger agreement's outside/termination date or whether substantial compliance with the Second Request has been certified — that certification date is the single variable that fixes the actual clearance clock, and it is the gap in this verification.
